hero_subtitle: Explore how North East Lincolnshire Council manages public money. Reform UK is the largest party (15/42 seats, 35%) after the 7 May 2026 election but the council sits in NOC.
publisher_bio: This website was created by Tom Pickup, Reform UK county councillor for Padiham and Burnley West and Cabinet Member for Adult Social Care at Lancashire County Council. He is also parish councillor for Clowbridge with Dunnockshaw. Tom builds transparency tools that make public spending data easier to check.

Cabinet Member for Adult Social Care, Lancashire County Council

publisher_quote: It's your money. The more people understand where it goes, the better.

political_control.tenure_note: Reform UK minority administration since the 21 May 2026 AGM. Cllr Oliver Freeston (Reform) elected Leader 17-9 (13 abstentions) with Independent Group support; all seven cabinet posts Reform. NOC: Reform 14, Labour 11, Conservative 10, Independents for NEL 4, Lib Dem 3 (42 seats; 22 needed). DSG high-needs deficit about £27.5m. Greater Lincolnshire reorganisation: statutory consultation closed March 2026 with the government decision pending (expected summer 2026); shadow-authority elections 2027 and a successor council from 1 April 2028; NELC's agreed proposal keeps its existing boundary.
political_control.source: NELC AGM 21 May 2026 + North East Lincolnshire Budget & MTFP (Cabinet 18 Feb 2026) + gov.uk LGR consultation (Lincolnshire, N Lincs, NE Lincs); verified 2 July 2026 (member index unreachable; AGM figures used).

doge_context.political_control: Reform UK largest party — 15/42 seats (35%) at the 7 May 2026 election. NOC. 2nd party Conservative.

spend_triangulation.note: Transparency gross = £1.10B across every class in the published corpus. Procurement-paid (discretionary third-party payments) = £962.3M. Non-procurement rows: Care-Act redacted direct payments to individuals (£133.9M), internal transfers to pension fund / in-house provider / wholly-owned subsidiary (£4.2M) — all excluded from third-party-supplier forensic analyses. Net revenue budget figures (where published) are smaller again because they net capital, grants received, and reserves movements — transparency totals include all of these.

procurement_paid.note: Discretionary third-party supplier payments — the real procurement footprint.

direct_payment_individual.note: Care Act 2014 + UK GDPR redactions — foster carers, SGO recipients, ASC service-user direct-payment holders. Lawfully unnamed.

internal_transfer.note: Council's own pension fund, in-house provider arm, or wholly-owned subsidiary. Money from commissioner to provider within the authority boundary.
